title: Ask before conversation text goes to the model: consent and off switches for Workshop and History summaries
summary: Workshop and History summaries now send conversation text to Claude only after a one-time consent question, with switches in a new Settings → Privacy section and a backend refusal while off; merged by the agent on the maintainer's explicit word.
friction: No screenshot of the new screens: the dev server's single port may be held by another session, so screen evidence waits for the owner's try-out
lessons_learned: Workshop test files need the Tauri settings-store plugin stubbed once a store reads a settings file; without it the suite shows unhandled errors and goes red
